name: week
title: Weekly licence desk
subtitle: Recorded evidence, not a licence certification

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by priority,name,issue

sections.title: Renewals
sections.sql: select name,reference,quantity,ends_on,days_left,proof from v_renewals order by days_left

sections.title: Coverage and unresolved rules
sections.sql: select name,metric,purchased,evidenced,required,stale,balance,assessment from v_position order by name

sections.title: Demand by department

sections.title: Removal needs evidence
sections.sql: select name,consumer,kind,department,consumer_state,last_used,reason from v_reclaim order by name,consumer
